name: Hitozuma Dorei Keikaku
source:
Takuya was a handsome youth who is a little shy, his mother died by suicide when he was a kid.
He came out his shell by the aid of his step mother Saeko and younger sister Hiyori. One day, he found out that the cause of his mother's suicide was adultery of his father and Saeko..... He made up his mind to get revenge against Saeko!!
"Sorry, mum..... I believed that bitch.....now it's payback time!!!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE029100]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
拓也是个英俊却有些腼腆的年轻人，母亲在他年幼时自杀身亡。
在继母冴子与妹妹日和的帮助下，他逐渐走出封闭的内心。一天，他发现母亲自杀的原因竟是父亲和冴子有染…他决心向冴子复仇！！
"对不起，妈妈…我竟然相信了那个贱人…现在该让她付出代价了！！！"

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE029100]DLsite English[/url]]
